The Aelarians explore their continent of Atlas, learning the ways of the world both arcane and mundane. They reach a low level of civilization before splitting across the world. Scholars agree they became Elves, and the Half-Elves, and some argue they even evolved into the races of Orcs, Leonin, and Halflings/Gnomes.
